$description: The overflow check's allow-list (tools/check-overflow.js; owner, fit-and-overflow stage 2). One entry per intentional case: { "selector": a piece of the element's selector as the report prints it, "page": a piece of the page address (never empty, never "*"), "kind": cut | spill | outside | page | multirow (optional), "reason": why it is meant to be so }. The report counts what each entry hid and names the ones that hid nothing. The first entries come from sorting the first report with the owner; there are none yet.
